Record Class MultiblockShape.Pattern

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.multiblock.MultiblockShape.Pattern
All Implemented Interfaces:
MultiblockShape
Enclosing interface:
MultiblockShape
public static record MultiblockShape.Pattern(@NotNull List<List<String>> layers, @NotNull Map<Character, Set<net.kyori.adventure.key.Key>> key, char anchor, boolean rotate) extends Record implements MultiblockShape
A fixed shape, like a crafting recipe in 3D: layers from the bottom up, each a list of rows from north to south, each row a string of characters from west to east. key says which blocks each character stands for; a space is any block (not part of the structure). The character anchor must appear exactly once: that block holds the structure's storages and must be a machine. With rotate, the shape is also matched turned by 90, 180 and 270 degrees. 
layers:                  # a 3x3 ring with a controller, a glass column above it
  - ["CCC", "C#C", "CCC"]
  - ["   ", " G ", "   "]
key: {C: mymod:casing, "#": mymod:controller, G: minecraft:glass}
anchor: "#"
